claims.content: Decisive for assigning a mediation task to basic or raised level are the complexity of the source text, the resulting functional text-shortening strategies, and any intercultural information to be mediated beyond the text.

claims.content: A basic-level task is further characterised by lower expectations regarding coherence, complexity, formal correctness and range of expression than at raised level.
